facts.fact: Minister of Posts, Telecommunications and the Digital Economy Léon Juste Ibombo announced on 13 October 2025 that the Digital Strategy 2030 document was complete and under review by the government's general secretariat before submission to the Head of State for final approval by decree.
The article says the Digital Strategy 2030 document was completed with World Bank financial support; it states no domestic budget line for it.

The Digital Strategy 2030, a decade roadmap covering digital public services, connectivity, youth digital skills, cybersecurity, AI and digital sovereignty, was reported complete on 13 October 2025 and moved to government secretariat review ahead of adoption by decree.

systems.tiers: described as the outgoing strategy the 2030 roadmap expands on; the article credits it with internet users rising from about 1.53 million in 2020 to 2.46 million in early 2025; coverage not described
